record.question: A solar cell is basically -
options: a voltage source, controlled by flux of radiation.
acurrent source, controlled by flux of radiation.
record.explanation: The usual solar-cell equivalent circuit has a photocurrent source whose current increases with incident irradiance, in parallel with diode/shunt elements. Hence it is modeled as a current source controlled by radiation flux, rather than an uncontrolled source. Reference: https://www.mathworks.com/help/simscape-electrical/ref/solarcell.html; https://ocw.tudelft.nl/course-lectures/solar-cell-operation/. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
